site.title: Brennan Heating
site.tagline: Gas Safe heating engineers and plumbers, Sheffield

categories.name: Areas
categories.description: Where we work, with postcodes and response times.

posts.title: Crookes and Walkley
posts.excerpt: S6 and S10. Victorian terraces, a lot of original radiators and some very old combis. Same-day emergency visits, usually within 3 hours.
posts.content:
S6 and S10. Victorian terraces, a lot of original radiators and some very old combis. Same-day emergency visits, usually within 3 hours.

Recent job: replaced a 2004 Baxi combi on Mulehouse Road with a Worcester 4000, same place on the kitchen wall, one day.

posts.title: Kelham Island and city centre
posts.excerpt: S1 and S3. Flats and conversions, many with underfloor heating and shared plant rooms. Parking is the hard part.
posts.content:
S1 and S3. Flats and conversions, many with underfloor heating and shared plant rooms. Parking is the hard part.

Recent job: new actuators on a six-zone manifold in a Cornish Place flat. Parking cost more than the actuators.

posts.title: Nether Edge and Sharrow
posts.excerpt: S7 and S11. Big semis with system boilers and hot water cylinders, some older than the owners.
posts.content:
S7 and S11. Big semis with system boilers and hot water cylinders, some older than the owners.

Recent job: took out a 22-year-old copper cylinder on Montgomery Road and fitted an unvented one in the same cupboard.

posts.title: Hillsborough and Stannington
posts.excerpt: S6 and S35. Semis and bungalows, plenty of back boilers still hanging on.
posts.content:
S6 and S35. Semis and bungalows, plenty of back boilers still hanging on.

Recent job: removed a back boiler behind a gas fire in Stannington and fitted a combi in the kitchen. Two days, one very dusty chimney.

posts.title: Dronfield and Totley
posts.excerpt: S17 and S18. Just over the border into Derbyshire. Next-day visits for emergencies.
posts.content:
S17 and S18. Just over the border into Derbyshire. Next-day visits for emergencies.

Recent job: first fix plumbing for a bathroom refit on Baslow Road, for Totley Tiling.

posts.title: Rotherham
posts.excerpt: S60 and S65. We cover the west side of Rotherham, mainly for landlords with properties in Sheffield too.
posts.content:
S60 and S65. We cover the west side of Rotherham, mainly for landlords with properties in Sheffield too.

Recent job: eight CP12s in one day for a letting agent on Moorgate.
